categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Modifies `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, which is covered under build's scope for CI configuration and scripts.
categories.rationale: Explicitly restricts GitHub Actions default token permissions to read-only in the workflow file. While Bitcoin Core's repository settings already default to read-only, specifying `contents: read` in YAML hardens CI runs against broader default token privileges in contributor forks.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Carries the maintainer Tests label, though it modifies CI workflow permissions rather than test harnesses.
categories.rationale: Restricting CI workflow token permissions does not affect test execution, coverage, or test framework reliability.
